# Precedent: Showing the Product Instead of Decorating Around It

Alternatives to abstract hero art: the product working, its real UI, its real content. These are
the anti-slop engine's first source of alternatives. Observed 2026-09-24; IDs refer to
`research/observations/`.

---

`W1` · https://wise.com/ · rendered — the hero is a live calculator.

`CG1` · https://chatgpt.com/ · rendered — the hero is the product's input, usable immediately.

---

## Summary rules

1. First ask: can the hero *be* the product (its input, its output, its content)?
2. If not, show real UI legibly; avoid tilted, glowing, cropped-to-nothing screenshots unless the
   content inside is still readable.
3. Place the product inside a world (photo, illustration) when context matters more than detail.
